name: Orlando Metal Fabrication
old_description: Orlando Metal Fabrication is located in Orlando, Florida, specializes in custom metal fabrication for both commercial and residential projects. Government and Private sector partners choose OMF for the custom metal fabrication projects. You can find OMF at 11516 Satellite Boulevard, Orlando, Florida 32837.
about:
Orlando Metal Fabrication was founded in 2005 in Orlando, Florida. The company began by producing parts for an OEM construction equipment manufacturer and later expanded its capabilities to serve a broader customer base.

The shop operates a 20,000-square-foot facility offering precision cutting (waterjet and plasma), precision bending (CNC press brake), and precision welding (MIG and TIG with AWS-certified welders). Additional services include design and drafting, machining, punching, pipe and sheet rolling, assembly, and a range of finishes such as powder coating, painting, zinc plating, cadmium plating, hot-dip galvanizing, and anodizing.

Customers span commercial and residential construction, government agencies, private-sector OEMs, and other recognizable companies. The firm’s early work for a construction equipment OEM remains a reference point for its ability to handle specialized fabrication requirements.

Orlando Metal Fabrication emphasizes a five-step quality control process aligned with ISO 9001 and AS9100 standards, providing dimensional verification and material certification on request. Its stated mission is to build lasting relationships by exceeding customer expectations for workmanship and delivery.
